brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: Pair A: piece:0,0,0 and piece:1,0,0, bolted together with jointBolt:0#0,0#0. Pair B: piece:0,1,0 and piece:1,1,0, bolted together with jointBolt:0#0,1#0.

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: All three walls between the pairs carry only double side connectors (connector:0#0,0|0,1, connector:0#0,1|1,0, connector:0#1,0|1,1). None of these walls has a joint bolt, because lockJoints was not run.

finish.summary:
I built two pairs of full hex bases, and the only things holding the pairs to each other are side connectors. Check_build found no rule issues and no mesh clashes.

- **Pair A** is the bases at (0,0) and (1,0), bolted together on their shared wall with jointBolt:0#0,0#0.
- **Pair B** is the bases at (0,1) and (1,1), bolted together the same way with jointBolt:0#0,1#0.
- **Between the pairs**, the two pairs share three seams. Each has a double side connector (connector:0#0,0|0,1, connector:0#0,1|1,0 and connector:0#1,0|1,1), and none has a joint bolt.

I capped the open outer faces with 14 solid end caps. I left out the lockJoints step on purpose: it would have bolted the walls between the two pairs, which goes against what you asked for. The build has 21 parts. It's structural only, so I didn't add any props.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
